Legal & Guidelines

Terms & Conditions

Clear guidelines governing the use of the official FitMate informational website and educational tools.

1. FitMate Member Access & Platform Pricing

FitMate is completely free for individual gym members to download and use without paying any FitMate subscription fee. Participating gyms pay for the FitMate platform. Individual gym memberships, class fees, and facility services are set and billed independently by each gym.

2. Health & BMI Educational Disclaimer

Information on this website—including Body Mass Index (BMI) calculations, standard adult BMI ranges, and wellness guidance—is provided strictly for general informational and educational awareness. BMI is a broad screening indicator and does not directly measure body fat or constitute a medical diagnosis. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for personalized medical advice.

3. Illustrative Previews

Sample schedules, attendance streaks, and conceptual mobile interface previews shown on this website are illustrative demonstrations only and do not represent live customer records.

4. Brand Assets & Intellectual Property

All FitMate branding, visual layouts, editorial copy, and graphics presented on this website are protected for official brand presentation and may not be reproduced or misrepresented without authorization.
